from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    exterior=set(); q=deque()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in (0,w-1):
            if grid[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in exterior: exterior.add((r,c));q.append((r,c))
    for c in range(w):
        for r in (0,h-1):
            if grid[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in exterior: exterior.add((r,c));q.append((r,c))
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]==0 and (nr,nc) not in exterior: exterior.add((nr,nc));q.append((nr,nc))
    enclosed={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in exterior}
    inner=set(); walls=set()
    for r,c in enclosed:
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]==1: inner.add((r,c));walls.add((nr,nc))
    # Add 2 on 4-neighbor outside cells adjacent only to line cells touching an enclosed cell.
    for r,c in walls:
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]==0 and (nr,nc) in exterior: out[nr][nc]=2
    for r,c in inner: out[r][c]=3
    return out

def parse(s): return [[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in s.strip().splitlines()]
